title: Watari Sakou's Honey Trap Method Manga Ends on December 1
content:
The 121st issue of Kodansha 's Ane Friend magazine revealed on Sunday that Watari Sakou 's Honeytra Method (Honey Trap Method) manga will end in the magazine's next issue on December 1. The manga's second and final compiled book volume will debut digitally on January 20.

The manga centers on Uta Manman, the only daughter of a family of spies, who would do anything to win the family succession, even if it means throwing away her virginity. Though still learning to conquer her weakness of doing honey traps, she meets a certain man.

Sakou launched the manga on the Palcy service on March 15, and in the 114th issue of Ane Friend on April 1. Kodansha released the manga's first volume digitally on September 20.

Sakou most launched the Tejō to Hachimitsu (Handcuffs and Honey) manga in Ane Friend in December 2023. Kodansha published the manga's second compiled book volume in December 2024.

Kodansha USA Publishing has released Sakou's 14-volume Cosplay Animal manga digitally in English.

title: 5 Classic 2000s English Dub Anime That Surpass the Originals
content:
The 2000s was an iconic decade for anime . Along with the 1990s, the 2000s was when anime was spreading into more of the Western mainstream, and it was when many modern anime fans got their start with the medium. There are a lot of 2000s anime that have remained iconic to this day and hold a special place in fans’ hearts. Part of the reason for this was the dubbing of the time. More anime were being picked up by American distributors for dubbing and platforms like Toonami made anime more accessible than ever and served as a gateway for budding anime fans.

The English dubs from this time are remembered fondly with some of the voice actors still being present in anime dubs to this day . Additionally sometimes the dubs were the only version of the anime that was accessible to western fans. This was also around the time when the quality of anime dubs began to improve, and these anime are proof of it.

5) Super Gals!

Super Gals! Is a shojo comedy anime whose dub differs quite a bit from the sub. The anime follows a group of Gyaru girls in Tokyo’s Shibuya district. It is a comedy that has a surprisingly good depiction of female friendships. The main group of girls give each other advice and are all together a fun, close knit group.

The distributor behind the dubbing was ADV Films, which was responsible for a number of English dubs during the time. It is also clear from the content of the dub that the distributor took quite a few liberties when it came to its production. There are language and jokes thrown into the dub that you can tell aren’t in the original Japanese release, and some of it has not aged well. Because of this, those who watch this show should be prepared for some language that isn’t appropriate today. If you aren’t bothered by the politically incorrect language then you can watch an anime dub that is inappropriate, but altogether a more fun experience than the sub.

4) Ouran High School Host Club

Ouran High School Host Club is an anime that has everything you would want from a shojo comedy. There are ridiculously quirky characters with noodly limbs, along with a fun, sparkly artstyle. The jokes in this anime are also hilarious partly because of the dub. This anime has so many iconic performances from now well known names such as Vic Mignogna and Todd Haberkorn. Their charm and delivery of their lines is what makes this a standout comedy anime for a lot of people.

This anime was released during a time when shojo anime was taking a back seat to a lot of the big shonen that were on the rise. Regardless, this anime managed to stand out with its fun cast of characters and comedy. The delivery of the comedic lines and performances of the dub cast are top notch and it is one of the comedy anime from this time that still holds up.

3) Black Lagoon

Even if you haven’t seen this anime then you’ve probably at least seen clips or images of one of the main characters Revy. She is a foul-mouthed and deadly mercenary. Maryke Hendrikse, the voice actress for Revy, really sells her slang and cold demeanor. Her performance alongside Brad Swaile, the voice of the male lead Rock makes for a fascinating dynamic between the two characters.

This is also one anime where its explicit language actually fits with the characters, and it is executed so well by the dub cast. The dub also features characters with distinct accents and tones of voice that feel like they fit the setting of the story. The Japanese language version, of course, has some of these accents as well but you won’t find nearly as much swearing or foul language there. Which ultimately feels warranted with these characters. This is one anime that has a better dub without it being too different from the original like in the case of Super Gals!

2) Death Note

The voice of Rock in Black Lagoon , Brad Swaile, voices Light Yagami in this classic thriller mystery anime. Swaile absolutely kills it in the role of Light and he makes the dub come alive and feel so unique. Swaile’s line delivery in the anime is so powerful that it inspired generations of memes to come. His voice sounds like a teenager’s but a conniving and intelligent one like that of Light Yagami. Swaile nails everything from Light’s obsessive monologuing to his maniacal laughter. He was truly convincing in this role and the same can be said about the actors that voice L and all the detectives that investigate Light.

The actors all fit their roles well and sound like how each of their characters should. The game of cat and mouse that takes place within this series is made all the more intense by the line delivery from the dub cast. The Japanese language version of this anime is certainly good, but the dub feels like something truly special.

1) Ghost Stories

This is a dub that certainly needs no introduction. Ghost Stories is an anime that gained popularity based on the outrageousness of its dub alone. When the anime was given to American distributor ADV Films, they were given full creative freedom to do what they wanted with the dub. ADV Films is the same studio that did the dub for Super Gals! only a year earlier, and they were known for putting in some pretty inappropriate jokes in that anime.

ADV Films didn’t hold back with Ghost Stories either as it has some of the most heinous moments and jokes that you can find in an anime, dubbed or subtitled. The whole thing reads like an ad libbed story though the dub maintains many parts of the original story of the original. Because of this, Ghost Stories is a type of comedy anime that is truly one of a kind. You won’t find moments like those in this anime in any other one you watch. The anime hasn’t aged the best with some of the language and jokes used in the dub, but it is truly a product of its time and one that should be remembered as such.

Were there some dubs that didn’t make the list that you like? Which dubs do you remember fondly from this era? Let us know your thoughts in the comments!

title: 'I'm Running for Crown Princess, but All I Want is a Steady Paycheck!' Manga Ends
content:
Seven Seas Entertainment publishes both the original light novels and the manga adaptation in English. Seven Seas describes the story:

Therese, the daughter of an impoverished marquis, works hard day and night to save every penny she can just to scrape by. One day, she's offered a chance to change her status and situation—by competing to become the next royal consort. Therese hesitates, unsure that someone as poor as herself could ever be a consort, and decides to decline the opportunity. That is until she learns that just being a candidate could lead to a high-paying position as a lady-in-waiting! Determined to take the chance, she decides to go for it. But when she arrives at the castle, she realizes that this competition is way more cut-throat than she anticipated! Can Therese's down-to-earth attitude keep her safe and above the fray? Or will this contest cost her everything?

Watari launched the manga on B's-LOG COMIC in 2019. Kadokawa published the manga's eighth compiled book volume on January 30. Seven Seas published the fourth volume in English on September 8.

Seo launched the story on the Shōsetsuka ni Narō website in 2016, and ended it in July 2019. Kadokawa published two volumes of the novel with illustration by Okaya in January and July 2019. Seven Seas will publish the first light novel volume on Thursday.

title: Seraph of the End Manga Ends on December 4
content:
The December issue of Shueisha 's Jump SQ. magazine announced on Wednesday that Takaya Kagami , Yamato Yamamoto , and Daisuke Furuya 's Seraph of the End: Vampire Reign ( Owari no Seraph ) manga will end in the next issue on December 4.

The series previously revealed that it would end with the 37th compiled book volume.

Kagami, Yamamoto, and storyboard artist Furuya launched the original Seraph of the End: Vampire Reign manga in Shueisha 's Jump SQ. magazine in 2012. Shueisha shipped the 36th volume on May 1. Viz Media publishes the manga in North America digitally and in print, and the company will publish the 35th compiled volume on November 10. Viz Media and MANGA Plus also publish new chapters of the manga digitally simultaneously with their release in Japan.

The manga's story takes place in a world where an unknown virus has killed the entire human population except for children. Those children were then enslaved by vampires. The manga centers on Yūichirō Hyakuya, a human who dreams of becoming strong enough to kill all vampires.

The manga inspired a 12-episode television anime series in April 2015. The 12-episode second season of the anime, Seraph of the End: Battle in Nagoya , premiered in October 2015. Funimation streamed both seasons as they aired in Japan, and released them on home video.

Kagami also wrote an original prequel novel series titled Seraph of the End: Guren Ichinose: Catastrophe at Sixteen , which Vertical published in English. Yo Asami drew a manga adaptation of the novel series. The manga's 12th and final volume shipped on February 2022. Kodansha USA Publishing has released the manga in English.

Kagami launched a sequel novel series titled Seraph of the End: Guren Ichinose: Resurrection at Nineteen ( Owari no Seraph: Ichinose Guren, 19-sai no Resurrection ) in 2017, with illustrations by Asami. Kodansha USA Publishing is releasing that series in English.

The manga has also inspired a musical adaptation .

title: HIDIVE Confirms English Dub for Nia Liston: The Merciless Maiden Anime, Reveals Series Leaving Service in November
content:
HIDIVE confirmed on Tuesday that it will begin streaming an English dub for the television anime of Umikaze Minamino 's Nia Liston: The Merciless Maiden ( Kyōran Reijō Nia Liston: Byōjaku Reijō ni Tenseishita Kami-goroshi no Bujin no Kareinaru Musō Roku ) light novel series beginning on November 18. New dub episodes will air on Wednesdays.

The following series will also leave the platform in November:

• Blue Drop - November 16

• Chihayafuru Season 3 - November 22

• Tears to Tiara - November 23

• Amagami SS and SS+ - November 30

• Heavy Metal L-Gaim - November 30

• Kill Me Baby - November 30

• Panzer World Galient - November 30

• Aragne: Sign of Vermillion - November 30

• Fate/kaleid liner PRISMA ILLYA – The vow in the snow - November 30

• Fate/kaleid liner Prisma Illya: Prisma-Phantasm - November 30

J-Novel Club releases the novels digitally and describes the story:

A great hero lies undefeated on her deathbed, regretting that she never found a foe who could take her down. She never intended to meet her fate anywhere other than on the battlefield, and her peaceful demise has her wishing desperately that things could have been different...But when she suddenly comes to in the body of the young, frail Nia Liston, she's got an all-new fight ahead of her. Nia is a sickly child, meaning she has a long way to go before she's in fighting form. Now that she's been given a second shot at life, however, she's determined to get what she wants. She's going to live—and die—for battle this time! Make way for the Merciless Maiden!

The anime premiered on October 6 on Tokyo MX , BS NTV , and MBS channels, and will run for two consecutive cours (quarters of a year). The anime also streamd on ABEMA , d Anime Store , and U-NEXT after its broadcast. HIDIVE is streaming the anime as it airs.

Minamino launched the story on the Shōsetsuka ni Narō website in 2019, and ended its run there in 2021. Hobby Japan started publishing the novels with illustrations by Jishaku in September 2022. Katana Canata started drawing the novels' illustration from its third volume in 2023. (The anime credits both illustrators for the original character designs.) Hobby Japan published the 12th volume on October 1.

Kabuto Kodai launched the novels' manga adaptation on Square Enix 's Manga UP! service in 2022. Square Enix published the manga's first compiled book volume in May 2023, and published the ninth volume on October 7. Square Enix 's Manga UP! Global service publishes the manga in English.

title: Crunchyroll’s 2026 Anime of the Year May Have Just Been Decided
content:
The anime returning for its second season on Crunchyroll this Fall may have just cemented its position as the platform’s Anime of the Year. With the year about to end and all the new anime scheduled for release having finally premiered, it is now a good time to start analyzing which series could take the throne. This year has seen plenty of epic titles, including Jujutsu Kaisen , which has claimed the Anime of the Year title for both of its seasons. Winter also saw the release of Frieren Season 2. However, several other notable titles have also premiered, including Jaadugar: A Witch in Mongolia and Bleach , which are both strong contenders.

However, one particular anime, which premiered at the start of the Fall season, has been thriving more than any other series. Considering that Crunchyroll’s Anime Awards are based entirely on fan votes, this anime is already surpassing several of this year’s titles in ratings, giving it a strong chance of becoming the Anime of the Year based purely on fan support. The anime in question is Black Clover , which has already established a strong position and is looking increasingly likely to claim the title. What further strengthens Black Clover ‘s chances of winning is another factor that also helped Solo Leveling secure the Anime of the Year title for its first season.

Fall 2026’s Biggest Returning Anime May Have Just Cemented Its Place as Crunchyroll’s Anime of the Year

Black Clover Season 2’s premiere episode blew every other anime premiere this year on Crunchyroll out of the water, earning more than 130K likes and surpassing even the premieres of other major anime, including Jujutsu Kaisen and Frieren . This highlights how much fans are enjoying Black Clover ‘s return after five years . This is further supported by the IMDb ratings for its episodes, all of which have scored above 9, with the latest episode currently sitting at a 9.9 rating based on 23K fan votes at the time of writing. However, the biggest factor that could help Black Clover become the Anime of the Year is a pattern that also helped Solo Leveling achieve the title.

It has become evident that Black Clover Season 2 will be split into two cours, with the first already released and the second potentially arriving in the spring. If the second and final cour of Black Clover does arrive in April, just as fans begin voting for the Crunchyroll Anime Awards, the hype surrounding the second part could also help boost votes for the first, much like the hype surrounding Solo Leveling ‘s second season helped its first season win the award . This is a major factor that could make Black Clover Season 2 a strong contender for the Anime of the Year title. However, another significant factor that could influence fans to vote for either Black Clover or Bleach is how both anime depict the final moments of their respective stories.

Just as My Hero Academia secured the Anime of the Year title thanks to the emotional attachment fans had to its final season, alongside its overall quality, Black Clover and Bleach hold a similar position. However, Black Clover is making a particularly strong impression right now, and with its second part potentially releasing next year during the Crunchyroll Anime Awards voting period, its chances of winning the Anime of the Year title for 2026 have skyrocketed.

title: The Super Mario Galaxy Movie, Resident Evil Reboot Film Earn Nominations for Hollywood Music in Media Awards
content:
The awards ceremony will take place on November 18 at the Avalon Hollywood.

The Super Mario Galaxy Movie — Nintendo , Illumination, and Universal Pictures ' sequel to The Super Mario Bros. Movie — opened in the United States and the United Kingdom on April 1, in other select territories on April 3, and in Japan on April 24.

Sony Pictures Entertainment 's live-action film reboot of CAPCOM 's Resident Evil survival horror game franchise opened in the United States on September 18. The film ranked at #1 and earned an estimated US$60 million in its opening weekend in the U.S. The film opened in Japan on October 9, and ranked at #2 in its opening weekend.

Monster Hunter Outlanders , a new game based on CAPCOM 's Monster Hunter action game franchise , launched for iOS and Android devices on October 29. The game's mainland China version is scheduled for 2027

title: HIDIVE Confirms English Dub for Nia Liston: The Merciless Maiden Anime, Series Leaving Service in November
content:
HIDIVE confirmed on Tuesday that it will begin streaming an English dub for the television anime of Umikaze Minamino 's Nia Liston: The Merciless Maiden ( Kyōran Reijō Nia Liston: Byōjaku Reijō ni Tenseishita Kami-goroshi no Bujin no Kareinaru Musō Roku ) light novel series beginning on November 18. New dub episodes will air on Wednesdays.

The following series will also leave the platform in November:

• Blue Drop - November 16

• Chihayafuru Season 3 - November 22

• Tears to Tiara - November 23

• Amagami SS and SS+ - November 30

• Heavy Metal L-Gaim - November 30

• Kill Me Baby - November 30

• Panzer World Galient - November 30

• Aragne: Sign of Vermillion - November 30

• Fate/kaleid liner PRISMA ILLYA – The vow in the snow - November 30

• Fate/kaleid liner Prisma Illya: Prisma-Phantasm - November 30

J-Novel Club releases the novels digitally and describes the story:

A great hero lies undefeated on her deathbed, regretting that she never found a foe who could take her down. She never intended to meet her fate anywhere other than on the battlefield, and her peaceful demise has her wishing desperately that things could have been different...But when she suddenly comes to in the body of the young, frail Nia Liston, she's got an all-new fight ahead of her. Nia is a sickly child, meaning she has a long way to go before she's in fighting form. Now that she's been given a second shot at life, however, she's determined to get what she wants. She's going to live—and die—for battle this time! Make way for the Merciless Maiden!

The anime premiered on October 6 on Tokyo MX , BS NTV , and MBS channels, and will run for two consecutive cours (quarters of a year). The anime also streamd on ABEMA , d Anime Store , and U-NEXT after its broadcast. HIDIVE is streaming the anime as it airs.

Minamino launched the story on the Shōsetsuka ni Narō website in 2019, and ended its run there in 2021. Hobby Japan started publishing the novels with illustrations by Jishaku in September 2022. Katana Canata started drawing the novels' illustration from its third volume in 2023. (The anime credits both illustrators for the original character designs.) Hobby Japan published the 12th volume on October 1.

Kabuto Kodai launched the novels' manga adaptation on Square Enix 's Manga UP! service in 2022. Square Enix published the manga's first compiled book volume in May 2023, and published the ninth volume on October 7. Square Enix 's Manga UP! Global service publishes the manga in English.

title: I Think Gundam Wing Hasn’t Held Up After 30 Years, But It’s Still Awesome
content:
A recent re-watch of Mobile Suit Gundam Wing made me remember why I loved it so much as a kid, but also why it’s aged poorly. The Toonami classic gave a lot of kids in the western world their first glimpse of Gundam suits, and the world around them. The sleek designs and brooding main characters made the show an instant classic. However, the corny lines and delivery proved that the script and voice actors at the time needed some fine-tuning.

It’s mostly unfair to compare Gundam Wing to today’s anime. Dubbing modern anime was still in its infancy at the time, so trying to fit the words to a show that’s technically saying something different isn’t easy. Furthermore, the show was incredibly intricate for a kid’s show. Nevertheless, the five G-Team pilots and their Gundam became mainstays in the anime consciousness, because the cool factor always reigns supreme when it comes to nostalgia.

Gundam Wing Succeeds Despite Confusing Plot

The constant political jockeying throughout Mobile Suit Gundam Wing made it feel like a Gundam version of Star Wars: Episode I – The Phantom Menace . The amount of factions that exist in this anime, and their brief descriptions made for a tough watch outside of the battles. Without a deep dive to make them memorable, I found myself regularly having to go back and re-watch scenes to make sure I was tracking correctly. The Colony Liberation Organization, G Team, OZ, Peacecraft Faction, which is also known as the Sanc Kingdom, the Romefeller Foundation, United Earth Sphere Alliance, and White Fang are all introduced throughout the show. This is a mouthful and nigh impossible to keep track of.

At the same time, it did bring about Zechs Merquise’s mysterious and mercurial anti-hero character because of the constant faction changing. His storyline alone might be the best of the series. A royal pacifist in disguise wanting to ironically use the very means his family and kingdom are fighting against in order to exact revenge. It’s a constant heel turn that keeps the viewer on their toes, which results in one of the best characters in Gundam’s history.

Furthermore, the main character fights just give off so much 1990s, WWE titantron, aura. The second the battle theme plays it makes the viewer fall in love with anime mecha all over again. Whether it’s Wing Gundam’s Buster Rifle attack, Heavyarms opening fire with tons of hidden gatling guns or Deathscythe slicing through fields of enemies, it makes for a worthwhile watch in spite of goofy lines and plot.

Gundam Wing Was The Perfect Bridge to Mecha Anime

Mobile Suit Gundam Wing’ s story doesn’t strike the same notes as the giants of the industry like Dragon Ball , One Piece and Naruto , but it’s a great starting point for all mecha anime enjoyers. And much like plenty of old shows that didn’t age well in the same kind of way, the nostalgia is still there. Power Rangers is a story far from a deep plot and has its own set of issues changing over from its original form of Super Sentai , for example .

Sometimes a cool giant robot battle is enough to grab the attention of young fans, however, and Gundam Wing might as well be the bridge from Zords to Gundam. It’s how Phantom Menace was still loved by kids even though its plot was pretty convoluted at times. The first time Darth Maul opened up the other side of his dual-sided lightsaber, for example, the theater went crazy and every forgot about the Trade Federation.

Heero Yuy flying up with Wing Zero and letting loose a double-barreled rifle attack on unsuspecting Leo Mobile Suits gave us the same feeling back then. What do you think? Do you still enjoy the cheesiness of Gundam Wing ? Let us know in the comments

title: Hollywood Reporter: Sony to Co-Finance, Distribute Live-Action Naruto Film, Begin Production in Spring 2027
content:
Destin Daniel Cretton ( Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings, Spider-Man: Brand New Day ) is directing the film, and is also producing the film through his company Hisako alongside Jeyun Munford . Arad Productions ' Avi Arad , Ari Arad , and Emmy Yu as well as Jeremy Latcham are listed as producers.

The official website for the Naruto franchise announced on July 10 that the live-action film project had begun a global casting search for the main characters Naruto, Sasuke, and Sakura, with casting for other characters to come at a later date.

The Hollywood Reporter had previously reported that Charles Melton (Riverdale, Beef) was "in final negotiations" to play the mentoring ninja Kakashi Hatake.

Entertainment news website Variety previously reported in November 2023 that Tasha Huo ( Red Sonja , Tomb Raider animated series) was working on the script for Lionsgate's live-action Naruto movie.

The Tracking Board Hollywood news website had reported in July 2015 that Lionsgate had closed the rights to adapt the manga into a live-action film, and had been in talks with Michael Gracey ( The Greatest Showman ) to direct. The Naruto and Boruto stage presentation at the Jump Festa event confirmed in 2016 that Lionsgate and Gracey were working on the film, and that original creator Kishimoto was involved with the production.

The Tracking Board also reported in 2015 that Avi Arad (Hollywood's Ghost in the Shell , Gamba: Gamba to Nakama-tachi ) and his son Ari Arad were producing the film at Arad Productions , and Erik Feig, Geoff Shaveitz and Kelly O'Malley were overseeing the film.

The Hollywood Reporter reported in August 2017 that Jon and Erich Hoeber ( Red , Red 2 ) were on board to rewrite the script for the film.

Collider reported in March 2018 that Gracey stated the staff were still working on the film's script because he wanted to make sure the work has the approval of Kishimoto. It is currently unclear if any of the above people besides Huo are still working on the project.

Kishimoto launched the ninja manga in Shueisha 's Weekly Shonen Jump magazine in 1999, and ended the series in November 2014. The manga has spawned the Naruto and Naruto Shippūden television anime series, original video anime ( OVA ) projects, several anime films, spinoff manga, the Boruto sequel manga and anime series, a series of novels, stage plays, and video games.

Kishimoto is launching a new manga in the franchise titled Naruto Shadow Rising .
